cause_quote: The new rail fell back to `session?.label || plugin?.value.label || tab?.label || t("presence.sessions.unavailable")`, and the new session opener used the same translation key for both missing sessions and failed lookups.
user_saw: Unloaded session pins and unavailable plugin pins showed “Session counts unavailable,” and opening a session pin showed the same message if the session was missing or the lookup failed.
summary: The fix gives unloaded pins fallback labels based on their type and shows distinct messages for missing sessions and failed lookups.
reasoning: I checked the introducing commit’s diff and confirmed that it added both the personal sidebar rail and its on-demand session opener with the unrelated Online session-count message already in place. The bundle documents the misleading label during ordinary navigation and shows the fix replacing all three uses of that message.
